'''Marina Dmitrievna Zerova''' ({{Langx|uk|Марина Дмитрівна Зерова}}; 29 December 1934 – 9 March 2021) was a Ukrainian entomologist. Several insects have been named after her. She became {{ill|Doctor of Biological Sciences|uk|Доктор біологічних наук}} (1980), Professor (1989) and {{ill|Honored Worker of Science and Technology of Ukraine|uk|Заслужений діяч науки і техніки України}} (2003). In 1981 she was awarded the {{ill|Award of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine named after DK Zabolotny|uk|Премія НАН України імені Д. К. Заболотного}}.<ref name="IA Akimov2006">{{Cite book|url=http://esu.com.ua/search_articles.php?id=16059|title=Зерова Марина Дмитрівна — Енциклопедія Сучасної України|website=esu.com.ua|date=2021 |volume=10 |publisher=Інститут енциклопедичних досліджень НАН України |isbn=9789660220744 }}</ref>

==Career==
In 1957, she graduated from the Department of Invertebrate Zoology in the Faculty of Biology, University of Kiyv. She had specialised in entomology under the guidance of Olexandr Filippovich Kryshtal. Until 1963, she worked at the [[Zoological Museum of Kiyv University]], after which she entered the graduate school of the Institute of Zoology of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]]. In 1966, she defended her Ph.D. on research into wasps in the groups [[Eurytomidae]] and Harmolitinae. In 1979, she submitted a thesis on ''Hymenoptera (Hymenoptera, Chalcidoidea): morpho-biological features, evolution and classification'' for a higher Doctor of Science degree that was awarded the following year.<ref name="Korneev2009">{{cite journal |last1=Korneev |first1=V |title=Marina Dmitrievna Zerova - on her birthday |journal=Bulletin of Zoology |date=2009 |volume=43 |issue=6 |pages=S. 565–566 |lang=uk}}</ref>

In 1981, Zerova established a laboratory of entomological taxonomy and ecology in the Institute of Zoology of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]]. This provided training in identification methods as well as undertaking further research into these groups of parasitic wasps. In 1986, it was made into a separate department, which she headed from 2011.<ref name="Korneev2009" />

During her career, she described about 300 new types of wasps from different parts of the world, mainly of the superfamily Chalcidoidea.<ref name="NHM-Chalconid database list publication">{{cite web |title=Universal Chalcidoidea Database: Browse references: Z |url=https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/data/chalcidoids/database/browseRefs.dsml?initial=Z&beginIndex=260& |website=Natural History Museum |access-date=11 April 2021}}</ref> Some of these descriptions were in monographs in the series ''Fauna of Ukraine'' and ''Fauna of the USSR'' published in the 1960 and 1970s. She was also the author of ''Insect Determinant of the European Part of the USSR'' (vol. 3, part 2, Leningrad, 1978), ''Insect Determinant of the Far East of Russia'' (vol. 4, part 2, Vladivostok, 1995) and contributed to the ''Russian-Ukrainian dictionary of scientific terminology''.<ref name="IA Akimov2006" />

Among the genera that she described were ''Parabruchophagus'' Zerova, 1992 (Eurytomidae), ''Tetramesella'' Zerova, 1974 (Eurytomidae) and ''Elatomorpha'' Zerova, 1970 ([[Perilampidae]]).<ref name="NHM-Chalconid database list publication" />

Further insects have been named after her including the genus ''Zerovella'' Narendran and Sheela, 1994<ref name="Narendran&Sheela1994">{{cite journal |last1=Narendran |first1=T. C. |last2=Sheela |first2=S. |title=A new genus and a new species of Eurytomidae (Hymenoptera: Chalcidoidea) from Tawian |journal=Journal of Ecobiology |date=1994 |volume=6 |issue=2 |pages=141–144}}</ref> and the species ''[[Aprostocetus]] zerovae'' Kostjukov and Fursov, 1987, ''[[Encyrtinae|Eocencyrtus zerovae]]'' Simutnik, 2001, ''[[Entedon]] zerovae'' Gumovsky, 1995, ''[[Eurytoma]] zerovai'' Ozdikmen, 2011,<ref name="Özdikmen2011">{{cite journal |last1=Özdikmen |first1=H |title=New names for some preoccupied specific epithets in Chalcidoidea II: families Eupelmidae, Eurytomidae, Mymaridae, Perilampidae, Pteromalidae, Torymidae (Hymenoptera: Parasitica) (Replacement name for Eurytoma lactucae Zerova, 2008 nec Bugbee, 1973) |journal=Munis Entomology & Zoology |date=2011 |volume=6 |issue=2 |page=837}}</ref> ''Idiomacromerus zerovaae'' Doganlar, 2016,<ref name="Doganlar2016">{{cite journal |last1=Doganlar |first1=M. |title=Species of Idiomacromerus Crawford in Turkey (Hymenoptera: Torymidae: Microdontomerini) |journal=Munis Entomology & Zoology |date=2016 |volume=11 |issue=2|pages=317, 332–333}}</ref> ''Neruandella zerovae'' Trjapitzin and Ruiz Cancino, 2001, ''Tetramesa zerovae'' Narendran, 1994.<ref name="Narendran1994">{{cite book |last1=Narendran |first1=T.C. |title=Torymidae and Eurytomidae of Indian subcontinent (Hymenoptera: Chalcidoidea) |date=1994 |publisher=Zoological Monograph, Department of Zoology, University of Calicut |location=Kerala, India |pages=Torymidae and Eurytomidae of Indian subcontinent (Hymenoptera: Chalcidoidea)}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Her parents were the scientists mycologist [[Mariya Yakovlevna Zerova]] and botanist [[Dmytro Zerov]].
